description: This file defines the PrismaOOORepository class, which interacts with a PrismaClient to query out-of-office entries based on various date and user ID filters.

classes.name: PrismaOOORepository
classes.description: Repository class for accessing out-of-office entries via PrismaClient.

methods.name: findManyOOO
methods.description: Retrieves multiple out-of-office entries within a date range for specified user IDs.

methods.name: findUserOOODays
methods.description: Finds out-of-office days for a specific user within a date range.

methods.name: findOOOEntriesInInterval
methods.description: Finds out-of-office entries for multiple users within a specified date interval.
